scope: Post-hoc attribution of the already opened V1.6 final period; no strategy/model/order changes and no new holdout claim

valuation_rules.first_row: Initial cash at first open to first close, including first-day orders and costs; benchmark first open to first close
valuation_rules.interior_rows: Previous close to current close, including any current-open fills and costs for portfolio; benchmark close to close
valuation_rules.terminal_row: Previous close to final open for portfolio and benchmark; no terminal liquidation
valuation_rules.calendar_gaps: Weekends and holidays may appear as date gaps; the CSV alone cannot prove every exchange session is present

primary_market_regression: OLS portfolio simple return on constant plus CSI300 simple price-index return, interior close-to-close rows only, zero risk-free assumption, HAC covariance maxlags=5, annualize intercept by 252
sensitivity_market_regression: Same OLS/HAC on all rows including first open-to-close and final close-to-open boundary intervals; reproduce V1.6 estimate
annual_segments: Group daily return intervals by valuation date calendar year; 2024 starts at first open and 2026 ends at final open. Return and relative log wealth use all rows; annual beta/alpha use only interior close-to-close rows in each year.
rolling_regression: 126 interior close-to-close observations, one-step daily rolling OLS; annualized alpha=252*intercept, beta=slope, tracking error=sqrt(252)*sample standard deviation of arithmetic daily active returns; rolling estimates are descriptive, not repeat-tested significance claims
relative_log_decomposition: Fixed full-interior-sample beta b. Market-relative contribution per row is log(1+b*r_b)-log(1+r_b); remainder is log(1+r_p)-log(1+b*r_b). Sum exactly equals log(W_p/W_b). Remainder includes selection, styles, alpha, costs, model error and all unmodeled effects, and is not identified stock-selection alpha.
boundary_sensitivity: Report both all-row V1.6 regression and interior-only primary regression, without choosing whichever has a lower p-value
factor_industry_corporate_action: Deferred: no verified external A-share factor returns, dated industry mapping, raw corporate-action cash-flow feed in the permitted CSV input. Do not substitute stock-characteristic ranks for factor returns or claim independent corporate-action reconciliation.
